gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate opened 2022 with gross claims outstanding of $1,075.05m. During the year there was adverse prior-year development equivalent to a strengthening of reserves of $10.253m (0.95% of opening gross claims), described as a deterioration in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end. Management attribute reserve movements to adverse claims development on prior years (notably strengthening in 2019 and earlier), the war in Ukraine (impacting Hull/Marine/Terrorism), significant natural catastrophe exposures in 2022 (Hurricane Ian and Winterstorm Elliott) and inflationary pressures increasing claims costs.
